title: · In Focus | Martine Rose Named Balenciaga Creative Director: The First Woman to Lead the House in Its 109-Year History ·
original_title: 视野 | Martine Rose 出任 Balenciaga 创意总监：品牌109年历史上首位女性创意总监
excerpt: Martine Rose becomes Balenciaga's first female creative director, succeeding Pierpaolo Piccioli and starting November 16.
author: 撰稿 X Vivi 编辑 X RAN

blocks.text: On November 6, Kering announced the appointment of British-Jamaican designer Martine Rose as Balenciaga's new creative director, succeeding Pierpaolo Piccioli, who has just stepped down. Rose, 46, officially takes up the role on November 16, becoming the first female creative director in Balenciaga's 109-year history — and the first of African descent.
Martine Rose British fashion designer Born 1980 Nationality British Alma mater Middlesex University Career Founder, Martine Rose (2007–present) Creative Director, Balenciaga (2026–present)

"To be named creative director of Balenciaga is an immense honor. Balenciaga possesses an extraordinary heritage and a fearless creative spirit. Before me, a host of remarkable talents shaped the face of this house, and I hope to carry that legacy forward — writing a new chapter in its rich and remarkable story."
Looks from Martine Rose's eponymous label

Martine Rose founded her eponymous label in 2007, drawing enduring inspiration from London street culture, music, youth subcultures and diverse communities. Known for exaggerated silhouettes, unconventional proportions and the artful deconstruction of everyday clothing, she has built a distinctive design language and steadily emerged as one of the most influential designers in contemporary fashion. She was a finalist for the LVMH Prize in 2017, received three consecutive British Fashion Council (BFC) Menswear Designer of the Year nominations in 2017, 2018 and 2019, and took home the award in 2023.
Martine Rose accepting the 2023 BFC British Menswear Designer of the Year award

Notably, Martine Rose was also part of the original team when Demna first took the helm at Balenciaga, serving as the brand's menswear creative consultant from 2015 to 2018 and widely credited as the architect of Balenciaga's menswear identity during the Demna era.
Balenciaga menswear from Martine Rose's tenure as menswear creative consultant
In its statement, Kering said, "Martine Rose not only has a profound understanding of Balenciaga's creative core, but also brings a contemporary cultural vision that is entirely her own."

"Balenciaga has always been known for its bold spirit of innovation, constantly challenging convention and redefining the boundaries of fashion. Martine Rose embodies that spirit through a vision that is fresh, fearless and deeply contemporary. Her close connection to a younger generation and her sharp cultural instincts bring an entirely new dimension to the house. Her appointment reflects our determination to keep Balenciaga at the forefront of innovation, creativity and culture." —Luca de Meo, CEO of Kering
